setlist_extra.title: Stu Reads Birthday Wishes To Audience As The Boys Jam

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ice V** (1 review): Track begins with Persistence, with Ice V starting after four minutes [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Persistence**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [9]
- **Happy Birthday Stu**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Stu Banter/Birthday Card**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]

## The recordings

- **kglw2022-10-26.mk41** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 124 min [1]
- **kglw2022-10-26.vwmule**: source not stated; 18 songs; 120 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]
- **kglw2022-10-26**: source not stated; 16 songs; 124 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes strong bass presence, contrasting with weakness in other captures [6]
- **kglw2022-10-26.mk22**: source not stated; 20 songs; 124 min [2]

## Around the show

- Mics clamped four feet behind mezzanine, seven feet high on the rail [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2022-10-26.mk41**: taped by DavidPuddy; transferred by DavidPuddy; source: Schoeps mk41 > nbob actives > baby nbox > Sound Devices Mixpre-6 ii @ 32/48 [1]
- **kglw2022-10-26.vwmule**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: Microtech Gefell M21 > nBob actives > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (24/48) [3]. Also: Transferred from MP6 to iMac, tracked in Sound Studio, FLAC via xACT [3]
- **kglw2022-10-26**: taped by Z-Man; transferred by Z-Man; source: Schoeps CCM4V'S>Lunatec V2>Sound Devices 722 (24/44.1) [4]. Also: Processed in Sound Forge 10.0, CD Wave, then FLAC 16-bit [4]
- **kglw2022-10-26.mk22**: taped by DavidPuddy; transferred by DavidPuddy; source: Schoeps mk22 > Schoeps CMC1L > Sound Devices Mixpre-6 ii @32/48 [2]
